FN-G3IKA66-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 270
Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Sponsor: Representative Adline Clarke
Elections
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/10/2026
House Bill 270 as introduced would increase the obligations of the State General Fund for
election expenses by (1) an estimated $176,000 for poll worker compensation for each election
where in-person early voting is authorized; and (2) an undetermined amount for costs of
publicizing information regarding the early voting centers.
